name: Mystery
description: A secret; the term describes both a cult that teaches secrets and the secret magics themselves, represented as Virtues and Flaws acquired after character generation.

name: Mystery Cult
description: A secretive organization that practices and teaches Mysteries, counting members across House boundaries; also called the Esoteric Mysteries.

name: Exoteric Mysteries
description: The House Mysteries of Houses Criamon, Verditius, Merinita, and Bjornaer; Initiation into them is synonymous with membership in those Houses.

name: Mystery Houses
description: The four Houses of Criamon, Bjornaer, Merinita, and Verditius, the smallest of the 12 Houses, which tend to look inward.

name: True Lineages
description: One of the three groupings of Houses; Houses Bonisagus, Guernicus, Mercere, and Tremere are True Lineages.

name: Societates
description: Grouping of Houses comprising Flambeau, Jerbiton, Tytalus, and Ex Miscellanea.

name: Initiation
description: The process of learning a new Mystery, entering a Mystery Cult, or increasing status in one; it profoundly changes the magus and cannot be undone by magic.

name: Initiation Script
description: A written text, similar to a Lab Text, describing the rites, Quests, Ordeals, and Sacrifices of a successful Initiation; following it grants a bonus to the Initiation Total.

name: Initiation Total
description: Presence + (Mystery Cult) Lore + Script Bonus, compared against a Target Level (15/21 for known Minor/Major Virtues, 18/30 for new ones) with no die roll.

name: Initiation Ordeal
description: A terrible rite such as branding or walking through fire that permanently marks the Initiate with a new Flaw and reduces Target Levels of later Initiations.

name: Initiation Quest
description: A story-based requirement of an Initiation Script involving a journey, danger, and challenges; takes at least one season.

name: Unique Quest
description: A very specific Quest that no similar Quester could repeat, such as bringing the head of the Minotaur; grants +6 instead of +3.

name: Initiation Sacrifice
description: The least taxing Initiation requirement: a sacrifice of time, wealth, books, a talisman, or even an apprentice or familiar.

name: Ordeal Flaws
description: Flaws inflicted by Initiation Ordeals; they cannot be lost in play or overcome by Hermetic magic.

name: Sacrifice of Power
description: Taking a Hermetic Flaw as an Ordeal, considered mythically very appropriate for Initiation.

name: Experimental Scripts
description: Process by which a Mystagogue devises a new Initiation Script through risky experimentation using the Extraordinary Results chart and a validity roll.

name: Mystagogue
description: A magus who conducts Initiation or teaches Mysteries; a role rather than a title, often a senior cult member with high Presence and (Mystery Cult) Lore.

name: Initiate
description: A member of a Mystery Cult, or one undergoing the rite to become such.

name: Probationer
description: One who seeks entry to a Mystery Cult but has not yet been Initiated.

name: Mystae
description: A magus who has Mystery Virtues; members of a Mystery Cult.

name: Hierophant
description: One of many titles for the leader of a Mystery Cult.

name: Eremite
description: A magus who prefers isolation from the rest of the Order; a hermit.

name: Degree
description: A rank of status or Initiation within a Mystery Cult; each degree typically teaches a distinct Mystery Virtue.

name: Outer Mysteries
description: The most basic Mysteries known to all Initiates of a Mystery Cult, often prerequisites for more advanced Mysteries.

name: Common Magics
description: Mystery Virtues once secret but now well known throughout the Order, which any character may take at creation.

name: Esoteric Magic
description: Secret variations on standard Hermetic magic practiced by those who belong to Mystery Cults.

name: Mystery Virtues
description: Virtues gained through Initiation into Mysteries; they can be taught to non-Initiates only under special circumstances such as a Minor Breakthrough.

name: School
description: A loose grouping of associated Mystery Virtues, such as the school of Hermetic Astrology.

name: Philosophy
description: The pursuit and love of wisdom, often used as a code word for magic.

name: Secular
description: Worldly as opposed to religious; Hermetic magic is secular because Bonisagus removed invocation of names and powers from the Techniques and Forms.

name: Hermetic Magic
description: Bonisagus's closed, secular system of magic that directly manipulates magical elements of Creation without invoking spirits or deities.

name: Minor Breakthrough
description: Research achievement usually required to teach Mystery Virtues to non-Initiates.

name: Hermetic Breakthrough
description: Research breakthrough that may allow a hedge magic tradition to be adapted to Hermetic theory.

name: Hedge Magic
description: Non-Hermetic magical traditions; some have been reworked into Hermetic theory or Mystery Cults.

name: The Gift
description: The supernatural talent needed to work Hermetic magic; its social problems are well known, and Mysteries may alter it.

name: Parma Magica
description: The magus's protective magic, cast every nightfall; Rhiannon had to forgo it for her Initiation rite.

name: Oath of Hermes
description: The oath binding Hermetic magi; teaching Mystery abilities to non-Initiates is not a breach of it.

name: Wizard's War
description: Formal Hermetic conflict by which enemies could hunt down known members of a Mystery Cult.

name: Certamen
description: Hermetic magical duel; defeating a Tremere Archmagus at certamen is an example Quest.

name: Gauntlet
description: The test ending apprenticeship; many young magi fly the nest after their Gauntlets.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power paid as cult dues, typically a pawn a year, with seven or more pawns for a new degree.

name: Talisman
description: A magus's personal enchanted item, which may be sacrificed in Initiation; Darius sacrificed his long spear talisman.

name: Familiar
description: A magus's bonded magical companion, which may be sacrificed in an Initiation.

name: Regio
description: A hidden magical area; an example Initiation takes place in a regio beneath a cathedral.

name: Twilight
description: Hermetic magical state; texts written by authors close to Final Twilight are rumored dangerous to memorize.

name: Warping
description: Magical side effect from continuous magical protection such as long-term Fortification of the Memory Palace.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Resistance that spells must penetrate to affect a target, including spirits being commanded.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Magical link; a bound spell and its container become Arcane Connections to each other, and a fire serves as one to elemental fire spirits.

name: Might
description: A spirit's magical strength; a bound spirit must have Might at least equal to the sustained spell's level.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Magical ritual slowing aging; creating an enhanced one is an example of a favor between magi.

name: Memory Palace
description: A mnemonic structure of rooms and loci used in the Art of Memory, traditionally a square villa with a central courtyard; number of rooms equals Art of Memory score.

name: Loci
description: Locations within a memory palace, five per room, each holding a complex piece of information.

name: Heartbeast
description: A House Bjornaer magic that does not fit Bonisagus's theoretical framework well.

name: Corruption of House Tytalus
description: A recent infernal fall within House Tytalus that reminds the Order how easily magic slips into Infernal sorcery.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Both the ancient Roman priesthood and the modern Hermetic group that adopted its name.

name: Mercuralia
description: A Neo-Mercurian yearly festival requiring attendance.

name: Daimon
description: Spiritual intelligences, primarily of pagan heroes and fallen gods, more powerful than ghosts and elementals.

name: Gnostics
description: Those who sought salvation in secret knowledge; heretical magical religions of the early Christian era exterminated by the Church.

name: Hermetic Alchemy
description: Mystery school developed from alchemical knowledge first translated into Latin in 1134 from the Islamic world.

name: Hermetic Astrology
description: School of Virtues concerned with the influence of the stars on magic.

name: Divination & Augury
description: Mystery of divination; a wise magus learned through it that Flora was innocent.

name: Spell Binding
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue for binding spells into containers where a spirit is compelled to sustain the spell indefinitely.

name: Performance Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue letting a magus conceal spellcasting using the actions and words of a chosen Ability and maintain spells without Concentration rolls.

name: Planetary Magic
description: A common Virtue once a Mystery secret before being betrayed.

name: Potent Magic
description: Common Virtue; Major Potent Magic requires and replaces Minor Potent Magic.

name: Vulgar Alchemy
description: Common Virtue once a Mystery secret taught only by certain cults.

name: Withstand Casting
description: Common Magic Virtue listed in Chapter 4.

name: Cyclic Magic (Astrological)
description: Astrological variant of Cyclic Magic listed among the Curious Common Magics.

name: Magical Focus
description: Virtue that can be stacked Minor/Major through Initiation; an Astrological version appears among common magics.

name: Mutable Virtue or Flaw
description: Rule option listed among the Curious Common Magics.

name: Vulnerable Casting
description: Flaw listed among the Curious Common Magics.

name: Philosophic Alchemy
description: Mystery of the Hermetic Alchemy school.

name: The Lesser Elixir
description: Alchemical Mystery of Chapter 5.

name: The Great Elixir
description: Alchemical Mystery of Chapter 5.

name: Order of the Green Cockerel
description: Alchemical group described in the Hermetic Alchemy chapter.

name: Periapt
description: Hermetic Astrology Mystery.

name: Celestial Magic
description: Hermetic Astrology Mystery.

name: Magical Armillary Sphere
description: Astrological device described in the Hermetic Astrology chapter.

name: Magoi of the Star
description: Astrological group described in the Hermetic Astrology chapter.

name: Astrological Correspondences
description: Astrological reference material in the Hermetic Astrology chapter.

name: Hermetic Dream Interpreter
description: Divination Mystery Virtue.

name: Hermetic Spirit Magic
description: Mystery school of spirit magic (Chapter 8).

name: Hermetic Empowerment
description: Spirit magic Mystery Virtue.

name: Spirit Familiar
description: Spirit magic Mystery Virtue.

name: Inscription on the Soul
description: Spirit magic Mystery Virtue.

name: Living Ghost
description: Spirit magic Mystery Virtue.

name: Names of Power
description: Hermetic Theurgy Mystery.

name: Invocation Magic
description: Hermetic Theurgy Mystery.

name: Hermetic Theurgy
description: Mystery of theurgists seeking to become gods.

name: Theurgic Spirit Familiar
description: Hermetic Theurgy Mystery.

name: Ascendancy to the Hall of Heroes
description: Theurgic Mystery granting apotheosis into the Hall of Heroes.

name: Hall of Heroes
description: Destination of apotheosis to which the Philosophers of Rome aspire.

name: Hermetic Synthemata
description: Hermetic Theurgy Mystery.

name: Synthemata Magia
description: Hermetic Theurgy Mystery.

name: Great Talisman
description: Mystery of Chapter 10.

name: Consummate Talisman
description: Mystery of Chapter 10.

name: Arithmetic Magic
description: Mystery school of Chapter 11.

name: Hermetic Numerology
description: Arithmetic Magic Mystery.

name: Hermetic Geometry
description: Arithmetic Magic Mystery.

name: Hermetic Architecture
description: Arithmetic Magic Mystery.

name: Dream Magic
description: Mystery of dreams.

name: The Greater Dream Grimoire
description: Dream Mystery text described in Chapter 12.

name: The Dream Landscape
description: Dream realm described in the Mysteries of Dreams chapter.

name: Mercurian Magic
description: Mystery school of Chapter 13 tied to Mercurian groups in the Order.

name: Hermetic Sacrifice
description: Mercurian Magic Mystery.

name: Immortal Magi
description: Appendix topic of The Mysteries.

name: Ceremonial Casting
description: New Mastery Ability introduced in Chapter 4.

name: House Bonisagus
description: True Lineage whose magi study Mystery Cult rites seeking breakthroughs.

name: House Guernicus
description: True Lineage House.

name: House Mercere
description: True Lineage House.

name: House Tremere
description: True Lineage House (printed as Termere).

name: House Flambeau
description: Societas House; Darius and Lucius are its members.

name: House Jerbiton
description: Societas House.

name: House Tytalus
description: Societas House whose infernal Corruption remains in memory.

name: House Ex Miscellanea
description: Societas House; Diana is a member.

name: House Criamon
description: Mystery House of the Exoteric Mysteries.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Mystery House known for heartbeasts and shape-changers.

name: House Merinita
description: Mystery House of the Exoteric Mysteries.

name: House Verditius
description: Mystery House of enchanters.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The organization of Hermetic magi, divided into 12 Houses.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder who created the secular Hermetic magic system and welcomed the four Exoteric Mysteries into the Order.

name: Trianoma
description: Founder who worked hard to bring the Order together.

name: Flambeau
description: Founder quoted: 'Adjungite nobis an perete!' — Join us or die!

name: Criamon
description: Founder of a Mystery House.

name: Bjornaer

name: Merinita

name: Verditius

name: Diana of Ex Miscellanea
description: A Mystagogue of the Disciples of the Worm.

name: Lucius
description: A sodalis who vanished for three days last solstice, an example of suspicious behavior.

name: Svetlana
description: Maga making late-night journeys to Gallows Wood, supposedly harvesting vis.

name: Rhiannon
description: Maga undergoing an Initiation rite alone and without Parma Magica, who passes when a stag appears.

name: Hedvig of the Rhine
description: Legendary maga devoured by werewolves while awaiting induction into a Mystery Cult.

name: Winifred of the Four Oaks
description: Initiate of the Knights of the Green Stone who passed her acceptance by being frozen in fear.

name: Darius filius Xerxes
description: Flambeau Hoplite of Semita Errabunda, Initiated into the Legion of Mithras as Raven and then Bride.

name: Xerxes
description: Parens of Darius.

name: Pepino
description: Hoplite and Legion of Mithras member who introduced and taught Darius.

name: Sebastiano
description: Lion of Mithras and Mystagogue at Darius's Initiations, with Presence +3 and Lore 7.

name: Lucius of Flambeau
description: Founder of the Seventh Wave cult who self-Initiates into Affinity with Art (Aquam).

name: Flora
description: Maga falsely accused before Tribunal whose casting sigil was faked.

name: Constantine
description: Example magus who binds Sunlight Without Flame with a fire elemental.

name: Mari Amwithig
description: Constantine's rival, a Perdo specialist.

name: Tertullian
description: Quoted authority on initiation rites.

name: Mithras
description: Deity whose secret rites the Legion of Mithras teaches.

name: Knights of the Green Stone
description: Mystery Cult contesting the decline of magic, questing to bring magic fully into the world.

name: Mystic Fraternity of Samos
description: Pythagorean Mystery Cult that openly advertises its existence.

name: Children of Hermes
description: Mystery Cult seeking other cults' secrets for its messianic religion; requires vis dues and recruits young magi.

name: Philosophers of Rome
description: Hedonistic scholarly Mystery Cult aspiring to godhood.

name: Legion of Mithras
description: Mystery Cult requiring exemplary service to the Order; degrees include Raven, Bride, and Lion.

name: Disciples of the Worm
description: Mystery Cult whose rites involve an ancient crypt and the mysteries of the maggots.

name: Neo-Mercurians
description: Mercurian Mystery Cult of magical archaeology, celebrating Mercuralia.

name: Volshebnii Mechtateli
description: Dream society that recruits from younger magi.

name: Seventh Wave
description: New cult founded by Lucius of Flambeau to rediscover lost magics of a ruined Fens covenant.

name: Quaesitors
description: Hermetic investigators who observe cult rites.

name: The Church
description: Looks askance at magic practitioners.

name: Raven of Mithras

name: Bride of Mithras
description: Second degree of the Legion of Mithras.

name: Lion of Mithras
